title: Fees and validity for an NBI clearance
content: As of 2026-10-07, the NBI how-to page states that the basic clearance fee is PHP 130. The page adds an e-payment service charge. The official page does not state the validity period of the clearance. The page nbi.gov.ph/citizens-charter/nbi-clearance/ lists PHP 115, PHP 165, and PHP 415 without labels. Check the amount on the portal before you pay. Source: https://nbi.gov.ph/how-to-apply-nbi-clearance/ (checked 2026-10-07).
keywords: gaano katagal valid ang NBI clearance

title: Fees and validity for an SS number
content: As of 2026-10-07, the official page does not state the fee for an SS Number. The page does not state a processing time. The page states that the SS Number is a lifetime number. The page states that you use it in all transactions with the SSS. The SSS home page links a contribution table at sss.gov.ph/sss-contribution-table. This record does not cover that table. Source: https://www.sss.gov.ph/become-an-sss-member/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: Passport fees in the DFA 2022 Citizen’s Charter
content: The stored DFA 2022 Citizen’s Charter lists PHP 950 for a regular passport application and PHP 1,200 for expedited processing. This is a dated fee reference; confirm the current amount on the official portal before payment. Source: https://dfa.gov.ph/images/2022/Citizens_charter/Consolidated_DFA_Citizens_Charter_2022_1st_Edition_v4.pdf (checked 2026-10-09).
